datasets.deleteRuns: This action cannot be undone and removes all the data associated with {{count}} dataset runs.
datasets.deleted: Selected datasets will be deleted. Associated run items and media links are cleaned up asynchronously.
datasets.deleteFolders: This action cannot be undone. Selected folders delete all datasets contained in them.

experiments.mostRecent: No experiments started in the selected time range. Showing the {{count}} most recent runs instead.

sessions.switchViewHelp: Its content is hidden by the current view, not missing. <action>Switch the view</action> to see it.
sessions.firstObservations: Only the first {{count}} observations are shown here. <action>Open the trace</action> to see all of them.
sessions.fullMetadata: Some metadata values are too large to show here. <action>Open in trace view</action> for full metadata.

prompts.configHelp: Arbitrary JSON configuration that is available on the prompt. Use this to track LLM parameters, function definitions, or any other metadata.
prompts.changeHelp: Provide information about the changes made in this version. Helps maintain a clear history of prompt iterations.
prompts.protectedHelp: Protected labels can only be modified by users with admin or owner access. This prevents other users from changing or removing these labels from prompts.
prompts.managementHelp: Manage and version your prompts in Langfuse. Edit and update them via the UI and SDK. Retrieve the production version via the SDKs. Learn more in the docs.
prompts.referenceHelp: Referenced prompts are dynamically resolved and inserted when fetched via API/SDK. This enables modular design—create complex prompts from reusable, independently maintained components.
prompts.copyLabelsHelp: When copying latest only, labels referenced within the folder may be added to copied prompts so rewritten references continue to work.
prompts.sdkHelp: You can use this prompt within your application through the Langfuse SDKs and integrations. Refer to the documentation for more information.
prompts.exportFailed: Failed to export prompts. Please try again.
sessions.addQueue: Add selected sessions to an annotation queue.
sessions.traceCountHelp: The number of traces in the session.
sessions.startHelp: A session is a collection of related traces, such as a conversation or thread. To begin, add a sessionId to the trace.
experiments.remoteRemoved: The remote dataset run trigger has been removed from this dataset.
experiments.httpWarning: This endpoint uses plain HTTP: the payload and all headers — including secret headers — will be sent unencrypted. Use HTTPS for production endpoints.
experiments.defaultConfig: Set a default config that will be sent to the remote experiment run URL. This can be modified before starting a new run. View docs for more details.
experiments.headersHelp: Optional headers to include in the request, e.g. for authenticating with your service. Secret header values are stored encrypted and shown masked.
experiments.webhookHelp: Set up an experiment webhook to start remote experiments from Langfuse. Your service receives the selected dataset and run config, executes the experiment, and posts results back.
experiments.selectRemoteDataset: Remote dataset run triggers are attached to a dataset. Choose the dataset before configuring the remote experiment.
experiments.remotePending: Your remote experiment may take a few minutes to complete.
experiments.durationHelp: Average duration of the root span per experiment item.
experiments.datasetHelp: Choose the dataset to run your experiment on. The dataset structure must match the prompt template variables.
experiments.datasetVersionHelp: Run the experiment using the dataset state at a specific point in time. Defaults to the latest version.
experiments.reviewHelp: Review your experiment configuration before running it. You can go back to any step to make changes.
experiments.runNameHelp: This run name is auto-generated from the experiment name and can be used to fetch the resulting experiment run via the public API.
experiments.invalidTools: Invalid tool config detected on this prompt version. Its tools will be ignored when running the experiment.
datasets.sourceTraceHelp: Link to the source trace based on which this item was added
datasets.missingVersion: This dataset item either had not been created yet or was deleted at the selected version timestamp.
datasets.inputSchemaHelp: Validate dataset item inputs against a JSON Schema. All new and existing items must conform to this schema.
datasets.outputSchemaHelp: Validate dataset item expected outputs against a JSON Schema. All new and existing items must conform to this schema.
datasets.csvInvalid: The CSV data does not match the required schema for this dataset. Fix the errors in your CSV file and try importing again.
io.largeCorrection: The original output is too large to load here, so it cannot be compared side by side. Your correction is shown below and will be saved as-is.
traces.noMessages: No messages. Transcripts are assembled from generations and tool observations with chat-shaped input and output.
traces.setupKeysHelp: You need to create an API key to start tracing your application. You can create more keys later in the project settings.
traces.setupHelp: Setup tracing to track and analyze your LLM calls. You can create API keys and integrate Langfuse with your application.
prompts.importArray: File must contain a JSON array of prompts.
prompts.importTooMany: File contains more than {{max}} prompts — maximum per import is {{max}}. Split the file and import in batches.
prompts.importInvalid: Invalid import payload. Check that each item matches the Langfuse prompt export format.
prompts.importParse: Failed to parse file. Please upload a valid JSON file.
prompts.importPermission: You don't have permission to import prompts.
traces.detachedMisplaced: The one you opened is loaded separately, and appears at the top level because its parent is missing too.
traces.detached: The one you opened is loaded separately.
traces.firstObservations: Showing the first {{count}} observations by start time. Later ones are missing here — find them in the observations table.
io.correctionHelp: Corrected outputs allow you to save the expected output for a trace or observation. Learn more in the <docs>documentation</docs>.
experiments.signingHelp: Langfuse signs every remote experiment request with this secret via the <header>x-langfuse-signature</header> header. Store it in your service to verify that requests come from Langfuse. It can only be viewed once.
experiments.remoteSetupHelp: Enable your team to run custom experiments on dataset "{{dataset}}". Configure a webhook URL to trigger remote custom experiments from UI. We will send dataset info (name, id) and config to your service, which can run against the dataset and post results to Langfuse.
experiments.name: "{{key}}" is set by Langfuse and cannot be overridden
experiments.remoteSend: This action will send the following information to {{url}}.
experiments.remoteConfirm: Confirm the config you want to send to the remote dataset run URL along with the {{dataset}} dataset information.
prompts.deleteFolderWarning: This action permanently deletes the folder {{path}} and all prompts inside it recursively. This cannot be undone. If a prompt is still used in your application, your application will break.
prompts.copyFolderHelp: Copy all prompts from {{path}}/ to a new folder path.
prompts.rewriteReferencesHelp: Update references like {{source}}/... to point at {{target}}/... when the referenced prompt is also copied.
prompts.deleteWarning: This action permanently deletes this prompt. All requests to fetch prompt {{name}} will error.
prompts.deleteVersionWarning: This action deletes the prompt version. Requests of version {{version}} of this prompt will return an error.
prompts.labelHelp: Use labels to fetch prompts via SDKs. The production labeled prompt will be served by default.
datasets.foldersHelp: Use slashes '/' in dataset names to organize them into folders.
datasets.wrapColumnHelp: When a single CSV column is mapped to a dataset item field, wrap its value in an object instead of using the raw value. Example: {{objectExample}} instead of {{valueExample}}.
datasets.changesSinceVersion: {{count}} changes since this version: {{upserts}} upserts, {{deletes}} deletes
datasets.processingOrDeleted: The {{type}} is either still being processed or has been deleted.
datasets.validation.json: Invalid input. Please provide a JSON object or double-quoted string.
datasets.validation.schema: Must be a valid JSON Schema
sessions.addedQueue: Selected sessions will be added to queue "{{name}}". This may take a minute.
traces.outsideWindow: Outside the time window — starts at {{time}}
experiments.notComparable: Not scored: only one of the two experiments has a score for the item — or, for a categorical score, the item has no single value to compare — so it counts as neither an improvement nor a regression.
experiments.matrixScope: {{scores}} scores × {{runs}} runs, aggregated over the {{items}} items on this page. Deltas are measured against the baseline column.
io.audioUnsupported: Your browser does not support the audio element.
io.videoUnsupported: Your browser does not support the video element.
io.markdownTooLarge: Content is too large or deeply nested to render as markdown. Displaying as plain text.
io.markdownFailed: Markdown parsing failed. Displaying raw JSON.
share.publicHelp: This {{type}} is public. Anyone with the link can view this {{type}}.
share.privateHelp: This {{type}} is private. Only authorized project members can view this {{type}}.
experiments.missing.cost: No cost was recorded for this run. Cost is derived from the token usage and model pricing its calls reported.
experiments.missing.latency: No latency was recorded for this run. Latency is derived from the start and end times its spans reported.
prompts.frameworkHelp: See <docs>documentation</docs> for more details on how to use prompts in frameworks such as Langchain.
experiments.intro: Experiments allow you to test iterations of your application or prompt on a dataset. Learn more about experiments <docs>here</docs>.
experiments.runHelp: Run an experiment to evaluate prompts and model configurations against a dataset. See <docs>documentation</docs> to learn more.
traces.setupSdkHelp: Langfuse relies on OpenTelemetry to instrument your application and export LLM application/agent traces to Langfuse. You can use one of our SDKs or 50+ framework integrations. Please follow the quickstart in the documentation to add Langfuse to your application.
experiments.scoreType.NUMERIC: Numeric score. Averaged across the items. A numeric score that only ever holds 0 or 1 is still numeric — it is not a boolean, and 1 does not mean true.
experiments.scoreType.BOOLEAN: Boolean score. Stored as true / false and summarised as the share of items that are true.
experiments.scoreType.CATEGORICAL: Categorical score. Its values have no order, so there is no average — the most frequent value stands for the group instead.
traces.jsonDisabled: Disabled for traces with {{count}}+ observations to maintain performance.
sessions.invalidJsonPath: Invalid JSONPath. It must start with $ and contain at most 1,000 characters.
datasets.unsavedComment: Please save or discard your comment before proceeding
experiments.comparisonPageHelp: Comparing one experiment's score against another's is not something the items query can express, so this narrows the items loaded on the current page. Page through to check the rest of the run.
